title: Rick Takeuchi (business operations & analytics) — starts the 4-week Extern Corporate Strategy externship on the Incorruptible framework
summary: Takeuchi has started the four-week Corporate Strategy Externship that Extern runs with Eric Ries. He frames the goal as practical rather than academic: walking away able to size up an employer he is considering, or a brand he buys from.
attribution_title: Business Operations & Analytics · Extern Corporate Strategy Externship
blockquote: Over the next four weeks, I'll work through the Incorruptible framework: learning to read proxy statements, evaluate board composition, audit real companies through four analytical lenses, and translate that analysis into a career strategy.
